# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

2.
completion:
## functions creating a 'InspectionRecord' class
1. Use the name of the applicable company
2. Use the model code ‘ee1
## functions altering an existing inspection record
3. Add a unique serial number to each building (use the number pad on your computer or a separate sticky note).
4. Add a Date of Inspection
5. Add the name of an inspector
6. Add a section code title (these have been given based on the original inspection record)
7. Remove any text that applies ONLY to a failed inspection.
8. Replace the column 'Check' with 'Reason for Check' and include the section code. 
9. Replace the column 'Outcome' with 'Failure' and include the section code.
10. Remove any columns that overlap with Failure/Reason for Failure.
11. Add a 'Complete' column
12. Add two columns for comments & actions
